title: chrysojasminum bignoniaceum
intro: Chrysojasminum bignoniaceum, commonly known as Yellow Jasmine, is a flowering plant species in the Bignoniaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Chrysojasminum bignoniaceum include acting as a sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-inflammatory agent, which contribute to its calming and soothing effects on the body. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
